subsystems.name: Bottle body
subsystems.role: holds the water and provides insulation; often stainless steel or Tritan plastic.

subsystems.name: Sensing module
subsystems.role: measures how much water leaves the bottle.

subsystems.name: Electronics and power
subsystems.role: runs the sensor, Bluetooth and reminders.
parts: USB charging port or wireless charging coil

subsystems.name: Firmware
subsystems.role: converts sensor data into volume drunk and time-stamps it.

subsystems.name: Mobile app
subsystems.role: shows intake, sets goals and sends reminders.

buildSteps.title: Design the bottle
buildSteps.detail: CAD the body, lid, and electronics compartment, keeping it dishwasher-safe where possible.

buildSteps.title: Choose and place the sensor
buildSteps.detail: A load cell under the base or a flow meter in the lid; calibrate to measure volume by weight (1 g ≈ 1 mL).

buildSteps.title: Build the PCB
buildSteps.detail: Surface-mount the microcontroller, Bluetooth radio, sensor amplifier and charging circuit.

buildSteps.title: Write firmware
buildSteps.detail: Convert raw sensor readings to millilitres, detect drinking events, manage sleep modes to save battery.

buildSteps.title: Develop the app
buildSteps.detail: Create iOS and Android apps that pair over Bluetooth, store logs, and schedule reminders.

buildSteps.title: Assemble and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Fit the electronics into the base or lid, seal against water, and calibrate each unit.

buildSteps.title: Test
buildSteps.detail: Verify accuracy across temperatures and fill levels, and measure battery life.

prerequisites.tech: Miniature load cells and MEMS sensors
prerequisites.why: enable weight-based volume tracking in a small package.
power the electronics for days or weeks between charges.
provide the user interface for goals and reminders.
would measure actual body hydration rather than just water consumed, but is not yet integrated into bottles.

pathway.unlocks: basic awareness of daily water intake.

pathway.milestone: integration with smartwatches and fitness platforms
pathway.unlocks: automatic logging and contextual reminders based on activity.

closed-loop hydration management with drink dispensing
